title: Pick the scale for the work

do.text: Open on the scale the work is measured in (a sprint in weeks or a month), so every bar can be read and tapped.

dont.text: Don't squeeze short work into a year: the bars become slivers no finger can select.

do.text: Put rows under a few headings: groups roll their work up and fold away.

dont.text: Don't list every task flat: on a phone the reader loses which row belongs to what.
